reviews.text:
I will never stop thanking you for what you did for my dog.
We were terrified for her pyometra, but from the very first moment we felt cared for with professionalism, compassion, and great attention.
The surgery went perfectly, and you were also available and reassuring during the post-op period.
Thank you so much for taking such loving care of her. I recommend this practice wholeheartedly ❤️

Dr. Rapacciuolo, beyond his professionalism, is what sets him apart from his colleagues, his humanity and empathy! Before meeting him, I passed through many different practices and I realized that too many do this job purely for profit, but don't care about the well-being of our "friends"! Excellent veterinary surgeon! He helped my cat right to the end with every means possible and never sent me home because there was nothing he could do; instead, he even took care of my pain! I will be forever grateful to him 😊
Great doctor, practical and expert. Humane and love for animals. Always available to everyone.

Today the doctor neutered my pitt. What can I say? My dog ​​loves this doctor. He even had a needle inserted for anesthesia without needing a muzzle. My dog ​​has so much trust in him. If I could, I would give 100 stars because the doctor and his staff are truly exceptional.
The doctor is of a unique humanity

I had the opportunity to take my dog ​​to see Dr. Rapacciuolo, and I have to be honest, he was very kind, and I've noticed from personal experience that he's a very knowledgeable and always available veterinarian. I highly recommend him because, out of many, he's the only one who solved my dog's problems.

Absolutely terrible, absurd superficiality, my cat is at risk of dying due to lack of adequate therapy, I went to another vet who made me understand all the damage done. I absolutely do not recommend it.

I met Dr. Rapacciuolo when I brought him a very elderly cat from a colony in the Soccavo area, suffering from a carcinoma that had eaten away one of her ears, and the prognosis later turned out to be frankly dire. The cat was destined to die within a short time. In fact, a doctor had advised us to put her down. But fortunately, Dr. Rapacciuolo performed a brilliant operation on her, amputating the auricle and cleaning out the innermost carcinomatous tissue, as far as possible. Three years have passed since then, years of extra life that the doctor's skill has given to our cat, who still enjoys good health today. I must also add that the doctor, in addition to being a brilliant veterinary surgeon, is also a kind person, not venal, and endowed with great love and empathy for animals. And this, believe me, is by no means a given. Many veterinarians, even some very good ones, practice their profession solely for the sake of maximizing profit rather than for the love of animals. A huge round of applause for Dr. Rapacciuolo.

INCORRECT diagnosis and SUPERFICIAL examination. I brought my cat with one eye covered by the eyelid; he looked at it, conjunctivitis, gave him an injection from a capless bottle taken from the medical bag. He had me come back two days later in the afternoon. He listened to the heart, gave him another injection from the bottle in the bag; come back in two days. She is not well, any attentive owner knows this. Taken to another clinic, they examined her eye with the ophthalmoscope, X-rays and under ultrasound guidance REMOVED about 80 cc of fluid. They tell me she has a tumor; one eye has no pus, no scratching or protruding. It's a symptom of something wrong with the brain (instead in the abdomen). But he didn't look at the eye. Make your assessments.
Highly professional. A true animal lover. Highly recommended!

I STRONGLY RECOMMEND TO ALL THOSE WHO LOVE ANIMALS TO TRUST DOCTOR RAPACCIUOLO, HE IS NOT A DOCTOR BUT AN ANGEL, THROUGH MY EXPERIENCE WITH ANOTHER STRUCTURE LOCATED IN VIA MANZONI I WAS ABLE TO SEE THIS FOR YOURSELF AND I REITERATE HE IS …
